``` r
library(OpenMx)
library(fitDTVARMxID)
library(metaVAR)
library(manMetaVAR)
```













## Data Generation


``` r
taskid <- 1
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(taskid = taskid)
```


``` r
plot(data)
```

<img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-10-1.png" width="3300" /><img src="fig-vignettes-sim-rep-unnamed-chunk-10-2.png" width="3300" />

``` r
summary(data)
#>        id            time             y1                y2         
#>  Min.   : 1.0   Min.   : 0.00   Min.   :-3.1668   Min.   :-4.3151  
#>  1st Qu.:13.0   1st Qu.:24.75   1st Qu.:-0.1779   1st Qu.:-1.1083  
#>  Median :25.5   Median :49.50   Median : 0.5447   Median :-0.3993  
#>  Mean   :25.5   Mean   :49.50   Mean   : 0.5734   Mean   :-0.4059  
#>  3rd Qu.:38.0   3rd Qu.:74.25   3rd Qu.: 1.2960   3rd Qu.: 0.2786  
#>  Max.   :50.0   Max.   :99.00   Max.   : 5.8231   Max.   : 3.9639
```

## MetaVAR


``` r
dtvar <- FitDTVAR(data)
```


``` r
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)
#> Call:
#> fitDTVARMxID::FitDTVARMxID(data = data$data, observed = paste0("y",

#>     beta_lbound = NULL, beta_ubound = NULL, psi_diag = FALSE,
```

``` r
metavar <- FitMetaVAR(dtvar)
```

## MLVAR


``` r
mlvar <- FitMLVAR(data)
```


``` r
summary(mlvar)
#> 
#> mlVAR estimation completed. Input was:
#>  	- Variables: y1 y2 
#>  	- Lags: 1 
#>  	- Estimator: lmer 
#>  	- Temporal: correlated
#> 
#> Information indices:
#>  var      aic      bic
#>   y1 11983.28 12054.86
#>   y2 12613.56 12685.14
#> 
#> 
#> Temporal effects:
#>  from to lag   fixed     SE P ran_SD
#>    y1 y1   1  0.3348 0.0250 0 0.1485
#>    y1 y2   1 -0.1873 0.0189 0 0.0871
#>    y2 y1   1 -0.1673 0.0149 0 0.0533
#>    y2 y2   1  0.3039 0.0188 0 0.0909
#> 
#> 
#> Contemporaneous effects (posthoc estimated):
#>  v1 v2 P 1->2 P 1<-2    pcor ran_SD_pcor     cor ran_SD_cor
#>  y2 y1      0      0 -0.1761      0.0568 -0.1761     0.0568
#> 
#>

```

## Mplus


``` r
mplus <- FitMplus(data)
```


``` r
summary(mplus)
#> Error in coef.manmetavar.mplus(object = object, median = median): object 'burnin' not found
```


``` r
coef(mplus)
#> Error in coef.manmetavar.mplus(mplus): object 'burnin' not found
```


``` r
vcov(mplus)
#> Error in vcov.manmetavar.mplus(mplus): object 'burnin' not found
```

### Posterior Distributions


``` r
plot(mplus, what = "posterior")
```
